chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with pending kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient has experienced a progressive decline in renal function over the past 14 years, advancing from CKD stage 1 in 2010 to stage 4 by August 2024. Diabetes mellitus (type 2) manifested as prediabetes in 2009 and progressed to proteinuria and microalbuminuria, contributing to diabetic nephropathy. Long‑standing essential hypertension since 1997 further accelerates kidney injury. Metabolic syndrome, obesity, and osteoarthritis add to cardiovascular and functional burden. The patient is currently awaiting kidney transplantation and is managed with insulin, lisinopril, and supportive therapies. Social factors (unstable housing, unemployment, criminal record) and oral health problems (gingivitis, tooth loss) complicate care. Recent visits show continued outpatient management but lack recent vital signs, laboratory results, and clear documentation of diabetes control.

past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include prior employment (full‑time and part‑time), past stress episodes, and a previous episode of gingivitis resolved in May 2024. The patient has a longstanding history of miscarriage (1985) and has completed higher education. Chronic conditions such as earlier stages of CKD, microalbuminuria, and diabetic kidney disease are captured in the active problem list as part of the progressive trajectory. Social history includes a criminal record and long‑term housing instability.
